draft.subject: Quotes at Harbour Tool Works
draft.body:
Hi,

Your site asks buyers to call or email for a quote, and I read you are opening a second service workshop in Chakan. With two sites, repeat tooling orders by phone get harder to track.

A simple online reorder and quote page could take that load off your sales desk. Would a short call to see what that could look like for Harbour be useful?

Mitull
